validity.researcher_notes:
Could not independently confirm or refute LengthKnownKm=126 against the 94 km drawn route (ratio 0.746 -- essentially at the ±33% threshold boundary, RouteAccuracy=medium). This line is not an Intergas Central Asia trunk asset (it doesn't appear in Intergas's own Q4-2024 capacity-availability PDF used elsewhere in this brief, consistent with it being TCO/QazaqGaz field-gathering infrastructure rather than part of the ICA inter-oblast grid), so that ladder rung that worked for P3955/P3963 doesn't apply here.

What I tried: (ru) 'Тенгиз Кульсары газопровод км протяженность' and several variants, 'Тенгиз-Кульсары газопровод история ввод эксплуатацию год', 'Тенгиз Кульсары газопровод ТШО QazaqGaz попутный газ'; checked ru.wikipedia's Tengiz field article directly (no mention of this pipeline at all); tried Tengizchevroil's own site search results (nothing specific to this line, only general FGP/company-history material) and kz.kursiv.media's 2025-01-27 piece on the newer KMG PetroChem/TCO dry-gas pipeline deal (a DIFFERENT, newer project, not this one). One hit, knowledge.allbest.ru (a student-paper/referat aggregator), gives length=126km and diameter=1200mm identical to the sheet's own values and a construction narrative (Lines A/B started July 2008, 1067mm, first line in service ~16 months later) that doesn't obviously map onto a 126km/1200mm line -- I did not use it: it's a low-reliability aggregator site, its core numbers exactly duplicate GEM's own sheet values (rule 1 -- never treat something that may trace back to GEM as corroboration), and I could not establish its own sourcing. pricom.kz's 'А у нас - газ. Для вас' article (which discusses Kulsary-area gas supply) returned HTTP 403 to both WebFetch and a direct curl with a browser UA, so I could not read it.

Given the ratio sits right at the 0.75 cutoff and RouteAccuracy is only medium, a modest under-drawing of a real 126 km line is at least as plausible as a genuine length error -- but I have no independent source either way, so this is an honest UNRESOLVED, the outcome the protocol anticipates for a per-string spec with no public register.
